turns.instruction:
Using the attached complete property and geometry tables, analyze a three-span continuous beam with spans 5, 5 and 5 m along global X. Global +Z is upward. S0 at x=0 is a pin; S1/S2/S3 at x=5/10/15 m are bilateral vertical rollers. Every support rotation about global Y remains free; the beam is continuous without end releases. All spans use M1/B1. Case D is -8 kN/m in global Z over all spans; case W is +6 kN/m in global Z only over the middle span x=5 to 10 m. Define exactly C0=D and C1=D+W. Run first-order linear static Euler-Bernoulli analysis in OpenSees with self-weight disabled. For each of C0 and C1 separately, report all four signed vertical support reactions and all horizontal support reactions, signed uz at x=2.5, 7.5 and 12.5 m, and signed local M2 on both sides of the two internal supports at x=5 and 10 m. Retain signs, including any negative reactions; the rollers restrain both vertical directions. Label every value with its combination, location and unit.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
